name: hc360-sbom-tools
description: cdxgen, which .github/scripts/sbom.mjs runs to read the web apps' pnpm-lock.yaml, pinned with its whole tree in package-lock.json. body-parser is held at 2.4.0, past GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828, until cdxgen takes the fix itself. Install with: npm ci --prefix .github/sbom --ignore-scripts --omit=optional --no-audit --no-fund
